name: [ToP] DBZ Path to Power
desc:
🐉 Open-World PVE & PVP anime game
👊 Forge your own path to power by battling formidable foes, unlocking powerful transformations and showing everyone that you have what it takes to become the strongest warrior!
🆕 Current major update: Tournament of Power
🔒 Level cap: 5000

🔸 Free double XP every saturday & +25% XP gain every friday to sunday!
🔸 Dragon Ball chances are doubled every sunday!
🔸 Roblox Plus users obtain 10% additional XP
🔸 Join the game's server to get every new code and to know every upcoming feature!

❗This game contains flashing lights and effects that may trigger seizures or discomfort in some players❗
